notes.title: Weekly Update: Week 5
notes.content:
Fix bug: Heal soldier when promoted (Unlock skill)
 Fix bug: Remove skillbar when soldier leaves battlefield
 Fix Bug: The ghost of the dinosaur should appear correctly now.
 Fix Bug: Min visual bug when starting a run
 Fix Bug: When continuing a game, missing information from the waifu skill


The following bonuses are added:


 ❤️Noble heart : All soldiers recover health when starting a battle
 ❤️Oppressed heart: All soldiers recover health at the end of the first wave
 ❤️Generous Heart: All soldiers recover health when a wave ends
 ❤️Brave Heart: Deployed soldiers recover health when fighting a boss
 ❤️Strong Heart: Deployed soldiers recover health by winning a battle
 ❤️Intrepid Heart: A soldier recovers health by killing an enemy
 ❤️Dual Heart: Double any healing for soldiers


Probability in rewards is modified, so that the player obtains better rewards (Weapons, Bonus, Etc.), earlier in the run.

Changed Waifu Skill:


 Red Tempest: Go from 90 to 80 of energy required.
 Sky Glory: Go from 80 to 70 energy required

notes.title: Experience Gain Changes
notes.content:
Changed the ability to gain experience points without having to defeat a boss to unlock it.

Players should already have their experience points precalculated based on their current stats. Defeating a boss is no longer required.

What's next in development?

Player feedback will be taken into account to balance the game, if necessary.

Work is underway to implement steam achievements in the game, we expect it to be ready in November.

notes.title: Throb of Lovegirl will be released on October 3
notes.content:
After more than a year of development and some delays finally next week the game will be ready for download on steam. We hope you enjoy them a lot.

❤ Will the game come out in its final state?
The game is fully stable according to all our tests with our test users. Although a minor bug is expected.

❤ Will the game have a discount for its release? 
Yes the game will have a 10% discount in the first days of release.

❤ Will the game be updated?
Yes, there is a lot of content that we want to add and we will add it as soon as it is ready.

❤ Missing content interrupts the gaming experience?
No, the game is perfectly enjoyable in its current state, but we believe that the content that will be added in the future will make it much better and above all with more variety for you.

❤ What is the content that you are going to add specifically?

 More erotic interactive scenes.
 More soldier skills.
 More enemy types.


❤ What can I expect from the game as a player?
The game is divided into two different gameplays, on the one hand Alpha's adventure in strange lands, where he must defend the territories with the help of the recruited soldiers using his different abilities. On the other hand, when a soldier reaches enough experience in combat, he will be rewarded by Alpha in an interactive erotic scene, reaching ecstasy, unlocking new powers that will help him in the fight.

It has been a hard road up to this point so we are very excited see you next week.

notes.title: The development of the game continues
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038672/94b2a131b5e9e281416cfaf4707efa0437592a2e.jpg

Hello, we know that we haven't had much news lately about the development progress. These months we have worked on: 

 Adding several sexy scenes 
 We have worked on the development of the main story. 
 All comments about the game made at the festival have been taken into account (Comments within steam as well as outside)
 We have also fixed a lot of bugs to be able to release the game in a near perfect state, because we know how much it annoys you to play games without finishing :)


Additionally. Voice artists have been added to the project, so that the game is super juicy.

We know that the wait will be worth it and we will get a much more complete game with more enjoyable content.
